lines.label: Say
lines.text: I would like to cancel today. Please confirm the date it takes effect.

lines.label: Ask
lines.text: I would like to cancel. What do you need from me to do that today?

lines.label: If no
lines.text: May I have a reference number? I will also check with my card provider.

items: Note the date it takes effect
